validity.recommendation: Fix start geography: StartState/Province 'Makkah' -> 'Eastern Province' (Ash Sharqiyah / Al-Ahsa Governorate) and set StartLocation to 'Hawiyah Gas Plant'. Owner (Saudi Aramco 100%), Fuel (Gas), FuelSource (Al Hawiyah) are correct as-is.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Reasonably supported, not a phantom. A 'Hawiyah-Uthmaniyah gas line' is referenced by name in Aramco/trade coverage of the Hawiyah/Haradh gas-increment program (aramcoexpats 'Aramco Gas Increments and Unconventionals' describes '...a 56-inch, 1-kilometre section between the same plant and the Hawiyah-Uthmaniyah gas line'), and MEED 'Hawiyah pipeline programme progresses' documents the inter-plant lines in this corridor. Hawiyah and Uthmaniyah are adjacent Ghawar production areas (Wikipedia Ghawar Field lists them N->S: Ain Dar & Shedgum, Uthmaniyah, Hawiyah, Haradh), both host large Aramco gas plants ~40-50 km apart, so a direct plant-to-plant gas line is physically expected. NOTE the row's only gem.wiki citation is OPEC ASB 2012 p.75 (one generic bulletin backlinking 6 fields) which does NOT name this line or its specs -- weak single support, hence the independent corroboration above. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a gas transmission line between two Aramco gas plants; not oil/NGL and not plant-internal (a separate 24-in NGL line also runs Hawiyah->Uthmaniyah -- GEM correctly represents the GAS line, distinct from the NGL line). No concern. DUPLICATE: checked the full 40-row SA operating roster and the 20-feature GulfPub SA gas roster -- no other row or GulfPub feature is the Hawiyah<->Uthmaniyah gas line (P1905/P1907/P1908 are Haradh/UA->Uthmaniyah; P1912 is Hawiyah->UBTG-1-km0; GulfPub has no Hawiyah-Uthmaniyah entry). No duplicate. ATTRIBUTION ERROR (the concrete defect): StartState/Province='Makkah' is wrong. The Hawiyah gas plant sits in the Ghawar field in the Eastern Province (Al-Ahsa Governorate), NOT Makkah -- almost certainly a conflation with the town Al Hawiyah near Taif in Makkah region. Wikipedia Ghawar Field explicitly places all five production areas (incl. Hawiyah and Uthmaniyah) in the Eastern Province. Owner Saudi Aramco 100% is correct (Aramco operates all Ghawar gas plants and inter-plant lines).

validity.researcher_notes: The GEM spec (47 km, 32 in) is not confirmed by any independent source located. Available independent figures describe SEVERAL different lines in the Hawiyah<->Uthmaniyah corridor with conflicting dimensions -- a 24-in / 57 km NGL line (Hawiyah NGL plant -> Uthmaniyah), a new 56-in dry-gas line for deep ethane recovery at Uthmaniyah, a 28-in / 58 km line onward to Shedgum, and a 48-in / 25 km inlet-outlet line -- none of which is a 32-in / 47 km line. The row's own citation (OPEC ASB 2012 p.75) does not carry these dimensions. So the length is geographically plausible (Hawiyah-to-Uthmaniyah plant spacing is ~40-50 km within Ghawar) but the 32-in diameter is unsupported and may be a mislabel or a conflation of one of the several parallel lines. No independent value agreement -> not greenable. Capacity is blank and no independent capacity figure exists (only GulfPub's 300 mmcf/d placeholder, which is not a real capacity).

routes.corridor_desc: Short intra-Ghawar corridor running roughly S->N within the Eastern Province (Al-Ahsa Governorate), not Makkah. Wikipedia Ghawar Field orders the production areas north->south as Ain Dar & Shedgum, Uthmaniyah, Hawiyah, Haradh, so the line runs from the Hawiyah gas plant northward to the Uthmaniyah gas plant, staying inside the narrow (~30 km wide) Ghawar structure whose field center is ~25.2N/49.32E. Endpoint coordinates are APPROXIMATE, defensible from the Ghawar production-area geography and public map references (Hawiyah gas plant ~24.8N/49.39E; Uthmaniyah plant near Udhailiyah ~25.1N/49.30E) -- not surveyed. The ~47 km sheet length is consistent with this ~40-50 km plant spacing. Corridor direction and province are well-bounded; precise coordinates are not hard-sourced.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from named Ghawar production areas: Hawiyah gas plant (south) -> Uthmaniyah gas plant (north), both Eastern Province per Wikipedia Ghawar Field (verified: contains 'Uthmaniyah' and 'Hawiyah'). Coordinates are approximate anchors from the field geography and public maps, flagged low; none fabricated -- they fall within the sourced Ghawar polygon. Current sheet start 'Makkah' is wrong (see attribution finding) and should not seed the route; real start is the Hawiyah gas plant in the Eastern Province.
